violations.text: A bucket were observed in the hand-washing sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 10/05/2026
Inspector observed gnaw mark in a bag fish fry flour. PIC voluntarily disposed of product. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/05/2026

Raw animal foods (shelled eggs and beef) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (produce) in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 10/05/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (vegetable peeler and colander) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 10/05/2026

(Various food product ) was observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 10/05/2026

(Shrimp ) was observed thawing in a bucket of water in 3 bay sink. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must be thawed in one of the following manners: under refrigeration (41 degrees Fahrenheit or less); completely submerged under running water; as part of the cooking process; or in the microwave if cooked immediately after thawing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/05/2026

Working containers of (liquid and dry ingredients ) are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. New Violation. Correct By: 10/05/2026

The presence of (rodents ) is not controlled as evidenced by (droppings throughout kitchen ). The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 10/05/2026
(Various food product) were observed stored on the floor in the (walk in cooler and dining room). Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 10/05/2026
Cloth towels was observed covering wontons in walk in cooler. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/05/2026
Inspector observed single use containers being used to store produce. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/05/2026

The following non-food contact surfaces have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris: -prep units -bakers racks in walk in cooler -food storage shelves throughout kitchen -utility compartment shelves -wok/stove area -dr reach in cooler -exterior of blender Repeat Violation. Correct By: 10/05/2026

The floors throughout kitchen including walk in cooler have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 10/05/2026

A sheet pan, rags and container were observed in the hand-washing sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. PIC cleared handsink during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/24/2025

Raw animal foods (such as chicken) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (such as broccoli) in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. PIC rearranged food items during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/24/2025

The non-food contact surfaces of the refrigerator (near cooking line) have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. PIC also informed to remove cardboard from shelves. New Violation. Correct By: 04/28/2025
The handsink was observed clogged during inspection. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 04/25/2025
cutting board and gloves were observed in the hand-washing sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2024

Raw animal foods (raw chicken) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (veggies) in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2024

Cream Cheese was observed held at (50) degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling.PIC voluntarily disposed of food. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2024

The door to the outside, located in the back storage area, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2024
Various food product were observed stored on the floor in the (walk in cooler and dining room area ). Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2024
Cloth towels was observed being used to cover wontons in the walk in cooler. PIC informed to cease practice. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2024
The non-food contact surfaces of the (dry food storage bins) have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2024

The ceilings in the (kitchen and dining room area) area is in poor repair. Observed ceiling tiles with water stains. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2024
